text: Once the required closing fields are filled in, moving a deal to Closed Won creates the customer company record automatically. Reps do not need to contact RevOps to close a deal.
If a Closed Won deal shows Pending sync for more than one working day, open it and choose Request review. The request goes to the Sales Ops queue, not to RevOps.
From 1 September the Dubai region pipeline is MEA Enterprise. The old pipeline DXB Sales no longer accepts new deals.
Deals above 50,000 dollars need the sales manager's approval and then the Revenue Director's. HubSpot routes both automatically.

If an email draft looks empty after you are signed out, open Version history in the editor and restore the last autosave before Sunday at midnight. Your approver sees the restored draft when they review it.
